_comment: Offline raster packs built by build_raster.py from LIST ArcGIS cached tile services and uploaded by upload_r2.sh (manifest keys = pack keys; the app mirrors the key list by hand in app/src/config.ts — hand-curated wiring is a repo decision). bbox comes from regions.json[region]. 'prune': 'size<N@Z' is the legacy topo rule (descendants of tiles under N bytes skipped from zoom Z); 'blank@Z' skips descendants of tiles that 404 or are byte-identical to a learned sentinel (ocean JPEG, transparent no-imagery PNG). Licence: each pack declares the licence flavour it was verified under ('licence'); the live copyrightText must name exactly that flavour (CC BY vs CC BY-NC-ND are NOT interchangeable), or a licence_override with the exact recorded text must be present — any change of the live text aborts the build (see docs/LICENSING.md). Seasons: AerialPhotoYYYY = the flying season ending in YYYY; coverage is a patchwork (6-15% of land per season, measured 2026-09-10); the app stacks them chronologically behind an 'up to season' slider.

licence_override.reason: The 2020–2025 season services carry the CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 AU badge; 2026's copyrightText is exactly the tail of that string after the second (the HTML badge was dropped), and it is the same capture programme (48 delivered 2025–26 projects in Public/Indexes layer 100). Treated as CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 AU — Leo's decision, 2026-09-10. If the live text changes, the build aborts: re-verify.
